method: checkpoint.inspect_committed_metadata on both actual SW0150 work/{arm}_seed1/checkpoints directories
interpretation: Both arms accumulated additional committed updates despite intermittent external GPU occupancy. Existing queues and source/runtime bindings are preserved; no manual relaunch or migration.
limits: Intermediate checkpoint integrity and progress are not final segmentation scores.
Committed logical updates do not count any replayed work interrupted before an atomic commit.
